examples.text: yā pana bhikkhunī tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇeyya, pācittiyan'ti.

81280.meaning1: having stored; having kept; having placed
81280.commentary: (VINa) sabhāyaṃ gacchantena hatthapāse cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā'ti sace ghare aṭṭhapetvā sabhāye ṭhapessāmī'ti sabhāyaṃ gacchati, tena sabhāyaṃ gacchantena hatthapāse'ti hatthaṃ pasāretvā handimaṃ cīvaraṃ ṭhapemī'ti evaṃ nikkhepasukhe hatthapāsagate kismiñci āpaṇe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā purimanayen'eva sabhāye vā vatthabbaṃ dvāramūle vā, hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabbaṃ.

examples.text: ekakulassa aṭṭo hoti, antoaṭṭe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā antoaṭṭe vatthabbaṃ. nānākulassa aṭṭo hoti, nānāgabbhā nānāovarakā.
dāyajjabhāṇavāro niṭṭhito navamo.

81282.meaning1: case of dependency on a shameless monk

81283.meaning1: (of character) similarity with other monks; conformity with monastic behaviour
81283.commentary: (VINa) yāva bhikkhusabhāgataṃ jānāmī'ti nissayadāyakassa bhikkhuno bhikkhūhi sabhāgataṃ lajjibhāvaṃ yāva jānāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, cat'ūhapañc'āhaṃ āgametuṃ yāva bhikkhusabhāgataṃ jānāmī'ti.

81284.meaning1: case of dependency for traveling monks, etc.

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, āraññikena bhikkhunā phāsuvihāraṃ sallakkhentena nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthuṃ, yadā patirūpo nissayadāyako āgacchissati, tadā tassa nissāya vasissāmī'ti.

81287.commentary: (VINa) gottena'pi anussāvetun'ti mahākassapassa upasampad'āpekkho'ti evaṃ gottaṃ vatvā anussāvetuṃ anujānāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, gottena'pi anussāvetun'ti.

81288.meaning1: case of two (simultaneous) ordination candidates, etc.

81289.meaning1: with the same proclamation; ordained by chanting the kammavācā at the same time
81289.commentary: (VINa) dve ek'ānussāvane'ti dve ekato anussāvane, ekena ekassa aññena itarassā'ti evaṃ dvīhi vā ācariyehi ekena vā ekakkhaṇe kammavācaṃ anussāventehi upasampādetuṃ anujānāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dve ek'ānussāvane kātun'ti.

81290.meaning1: with various preceptors; with different teachers; having diverse mentors

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dve tayo ek'ānussāvane kātuṃ, tañ'ca kho ekena upajjhāyena, na tv'eva nān'upajjhāyenā'ti.

81291.meaning1: permitting full ordination twenty years after conception

81292.commentary: (VINt) gabbhe sayitakālena saddhiṃ vīsatimaṃ vassaṃ assā'ti gabbhavīso.

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, tadupādāya sāvassa jāti. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, gabbhavīsaṃ upasampādetun'ti.

81293.meaning1: process of higher ordination; performance of higher ordination as monastic

81294.meaning1: not advised; not instructed; not taught

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ananusiṭṭhe upasampad'āpekkhe antarāyike dhamme pucchanti. upasampad'āpekkhā vitthāyan'ti, maṅkū honti, na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ananusiṭṭhe upasampad'āpekkhe antarāyike dhamme pucchanti. upasampad'āpekkhā vitthāyanti, maṅkū honti, na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ. bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

81296.meaning1: should be made to choose; should be asked to take
81296.commentary: (VINa) paṭhamaṃ upajjhaṃ gāhāpetabbo'ti ettha vajj'āvajjaṃ upanijjhāyatī'ti upajjhā, taṃ upajjhaṃ, upajjhāyo me bhante hohī'ti evaṃ vadāpetvā gāhāpetabbo.

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ upajjhaṃ gāhāpetabbo. upajjhaṃ gāhāpetvā pattacīvaraṃ ācikkhitabbaṃ, ayaṃ te patto, ayaṃ saṅghāṭi, ayaṃ uttarāsaṅgo, ayaṃ antaravāsako.

81297.meaning1: badly advised; instructed poorly; not well taught

examples.text: bālā abyattā anusāsan'ti. duranusiṭṭhā upasampad'āpekkhā vitthāyanti, maṅkū honti, na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ. bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

81298.meaning1: should be made to ask; should be caused to request

examples.text: ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā upasampadaṃ yācāpetabbo, saṅghaṃ, bhante, upasampadaṃ yācāmi.

81299.meaning1: procedure of higher ordination; ordination ceremony

examples.text: upasampadākammaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
